edit.old: When a sentence's root is `identity-91`, choose as anchor the event inside the predicate noun that is most clearly placed in time, usually a completed past event (`(document-creation-time :before e)`). The triples are:
edit.new: With an `identity-91` root, the anchor is the event in the predicate noun most clearly placed in time (usually completed past):

edit.old: - for a reputation or property state of that noun, `(state :contained anchor)`. The state is the parent and the anchor is the child; the state itself gets no other temporal parent;
edit.new: - a reputation or property state of that noun: `(state :contained anchor)`, no other parent;

edit.old: - every other event of the predicate noun, including the means or reason of the reputation, is `(anchor :overlap e)`. None of them hang under the reputation state.
edit.new: - every other event of the noun (also the reputation's means or reason): `(anchor :overlap e)`.

edit.old: Entities and modifiers are the word itself, lemmatized in English (`doctor`, `health`) and as written in Chinese (`宇航员`, `航天器`).
edit.new: Entities and modifiers are the word itself, lemmatized in English and as written in Chinese.

edit.old: It is not an argument of the aspectual verb as well. Check the aspectual verb's roleset.
In N1 的 N2, and in *change from A to B* (从 A 变为 B), the grammatical head common noun is the concept.
edit.new: In N1 的 N2 the grammatical head common noun is the concept.

edit.old: Possession, belonging, existence, survival and knowing verbs stay `state` even with 了, 过, 曾经, a duration modifier or under *continue*. These markers only place the state in time for the temporal triples.
edit.new: Possession, belonging, existence, survival, knowing and stance (support, oppose) verbs stay `state` even with 了, 过, 曾经, a duration modifier or under *continue*.

edit.old: Use an abstract predicate only when there is no lexical predicate. A Chinese verb with its own PropBank frame keeps that frame and its roles. For example, a possession or belonging verb such as 属于 or 拥有 is that verb with its own fitting sense (see Chinese role numbering below), not `belong-91` / `ha...
edit.new: Use an abstract predicate only when there is no lexical predicate: a framed Chinese verb (属于, 拥有) keeps its frame and fitting sense, not `belong-91` / `have-91`.

edit.old: `(h / have-reason-91 :ARG1 effect-event :ARG2 cause-event :aspect state)`, `(h2 / have-purpose-91 :ARG1 main-event :ARG2 purpose-event :aspect state)`
edit.new: `(h / have-reason-91 :ARG1 effect-event :ARG2 cause-event)`, `(h2 / have-purpose-91 :ARG1 main-event :ARG2 purpose-event)`

edit.old: It gets `(author :full-affirmative h)` but no temporal parent (see 5.1).
edit.new: It gets no `:aspect`, no modal triple and no temporal parent.

edit.old: Do not re-enter the subject into 为/为了-purpose clauses or relative clauses unless a word fills the role.
edit.new: Re-enter a shared subject in a fronted 为/为了 purpose clause; not in relative clauses unless a word fills the role.

edit.anchor: A true idiom stays one concept.
edit.text: A demonstrative + noun token (该/此/本/这 + noun) is split: noun `:mod` demonstrative.
A role noun with only a possessor (其/its X, no name or title construction) is the noun + `:possessor`, not reified.

edit.old: publishing/posting verbs usually make the place published in a numbered argument (not `:place`).
edit.new: publishing/posting verbs: copy the frame's numbers (often `:ARG1` place/medium, `:ARG2` thing published). Saying verbs take the claim sense; 'serve as [title]' the position-holder sense. Check V出/V到/V上/V成 tokens whole first.

edit.old: When the root is a coordination, the first conjunct is the anchor; later conjuncts `:overlap` it unless an order word says otherwise.
edit.new: When the root is a coordination, the first conjunct is the anchor; each later conjunct `:overlap`s the one before it unless an order word says otherwise. For a `but-91`/`contrast-91` root, `:ARG1` is the anchor. A date only inside reported content gets no triple.

edit.old: X's event is the `:reason` of Y.
edit.new: X's event is the `:reason` of Y (temporal `:overlap` Y).

edit.old: as `:temporal` of the verb, with no date triple.
edit.new: as `:temporal` of the verb, with no date triple; a following 时 gets no node.

edit.old: - Link every mention of the main discourse entities.
edit.new: - Link every mention of the main discourse entities. Generic kind nouns (a class used generically) in different clauses are not linked.
